cases.situation: I'm a freelance photographer. Sent restaurant owner Luis a $2,200 quote for a new menu shoot on Sept 12. He loved it on the call, then nothing, even after one bump.
cases.reply: Hi Luis, since I sent the menu shoot quote, I finished a similar shoot for Bodega Norte, and orders for the photographed dishes went up about 20% in the first month. Is a new menu shoot still on your list for this autumn? A quick yes, no or not yet is all I need.
cases.note: Touch two adds something new and shrinks the reply to one word.

cases.situation: 我做室内设计，9月19号把效果图发给客户赵先生，十天了一直没回，施工队那边还在等排期。
cases.reply: 赵先生您好，9月19号发给您的效果图还没收到回复，想确认一下进度。如果您需要多点时间考虑完全没问题，告诉我一声，我好安排施工队的档期。如果想先暂停，也直接说就行。
cases.note: 项目中途客户沉默，给他一个说“暂停”的台阶，比追问效果图看没看更容易得到回复。

cases.situation: Mandei uma proposta de site para uma clínica veterinária há um mês e meio. Já mandei dois follow-ups e nada. Quero encerrar com elegância.
cases.reply: Oi, Dra. Paula, vou considerar que o momento não é o ideal e encerrar a proposta por aqui, para não lotar sua caixa de entrada. Se o site voltar à pauta, vou gostar muito de ajudar, é só responder este e-mail. Boa sorte com a nova unidade da clínica!
cases.note: The clean close often gets the reply the follow-ups didn't. If she comes back later, re-scope from today's rates.

cases.situation: Freelance web developer. A dental practice manager, Karen, went silent on my $6,500 quote back in April and I sent a clean close in May. She just emailed asking if we can start next Monday at the April price.
cases.reply: Hi Karen, good to hear from you, and I'd be glad to pick this up. My schedule and rates have moved since April, so the quote needs a refresh: the same scope is now $7,200, and the earliest I can start is Monday 19 October. I'll send the updated proposal by Thursday so you have it in writing. Does that timing work on your side?
cases.note: Resurfacing after the close: no reproach for the silence, and re-scope from today's rates and calendar rather than honouring a stale quote.
